payload.rationale: The obligation asks, for Outfall 001, which of eight parameters (Flow, dissolved copper, dissolved cadmium, hardness, TSS monthly average, TSS daily maximum, total aluminum, total copper) support numeric exceedance comparison versus report-only monitoring. The packet supplies limit-table excerpts for Flow, Dissolved Copper, and Total Suspended Solids only. Flow is listed as Report MGD in both limit columns (per-parameter REJECT for numeric comparison). Dissolved Copper is Report/Report (per-parameter REJECT). For Total Suspended Solids, one column is Report (per-parameter REJECT for monthly average) and another is 50 (per-parameter ACCEPT for daily maximum numeric comparison). No packet span establishes limits or monitoring basis for dissolved cadmium, hardness, total aluminum, or total copper. Because four of the eight requested parameters lack establishing evidence, the full proposition cannot be closed. Per P5, unsupported uncertainty is preferred over unsupported semantic closure; overall disposition is UNRESOLVED, with the partial per-parameter judgments above noted in rationale only.
